wp_parent:
CREATE TABLE `wp_parent` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `code` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `code` (`code`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci
wp_child;x:
CREATE TABLE `wp_child;x` (
  `id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `parent_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `parent_code` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `qty` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'a; b ''c'' REFERENCES `wp_parent`',
  `total` int(11) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (`qty` * 2) VIRTUAL,
  `total2` int(11) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (`qty` + 1) STORED,
  `meta` longtext CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin DEFAULT NULL CHECK (json_valid(`meta`)),
  `title` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `pt` point NOT NULL,
  `created` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `parent` (`parent_id`),
  KEY `title_prefix` (`title`(20)),
  SPATIAL KEY `sp` (`pt`),
  KEY `parent_code` (`parent_code`),
  FULLTEXT KEY `ft` (`title`),
  CONSTRAINT `1` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_code`) REFERENCES `wp_parent` (`code`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_child_parent` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_id`) REFERENCES `wp_parent` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `qty_positive` CHECK (`qty` >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT `CONSTRAINT_1` CHECK (`qty` < 1000000)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci COMMENT='x;y'
wp_part:
CREATE TABLE `wp_part` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `d` date NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`,`d`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci
 PARTITION BY RANGE (year(`d`))
(PARTITION `p0` VALUES LESS THAN (2020) ENGINE = InnoDB,
 PARTITION `p1` VALUES LESS THAN MAXVALUE ENGINE = InnoDB)
wp_inv:

  `secret` int(11) DEFAULT NULL INVISIBLE,

) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci
